High School Return of a Gangster

조폭인 내가 고등학생이 되었습니다

K-Drama · Series · South Korea · 2024

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐∞/10

Overview

Kim Deuk-pal, a 47-year-old gangster who regrets never finishing school, unexpectedly possesses the body of high school student Song Yi-heon, who had attempted suicide due to severe bullying. Living as Yi-heon, Deuk-pal protects him from bullies, builds genuine friendships, heals broken relationships, and proves that learning and personal growth have no age limit.

My Review

I really loved this series. It made me realize that everyone has the right to learn and receive an education regardless of their age. I love the idea that Kim Deuk-pal was given the chance to live through the body of Song Yi-heon after saving him from jumping onto the road. Instead of wasting the opportunity, he fixed the painful past Yi-heon had lived through. He made real friends, protected Yi-heon's mother, stood up against bullies, and changed Yi-heon's entire life. I honestly didn't expect the ending because I thought Yi-heon would return to his own body and Deuk-pal would finally go to heaven. Then... boom. It didn't happen. I also loved the chemistry between Yi-heon and Se-kyung. I hope those two actors will have a BL series someday. HEHEHE. The series was so good. It reminds us that learning never stops, no matter how old we become.

Favorite Scene/Part

• Deuk-pal first waking up inside Yi-heon's body. • Every scene where he teaches the school bullies a lesson. • Yi-heon slowly making genuine friends. • Deuk-pal protecting Yi-heon's mother. • The emotional ending where expectations were completely overturned.

Favorite Quote/Lines

"No matter how persistently you try, many things go against your will. Still, you can't give up first."
